# aether_node_pool_machines (Data Source)

The machines (nodes) of a node pool, sorted by name, as the platform currently sees them. An empty list is also what the platform returns when it cannot read the cluster's machines; `age_seconds` changes on every read; `k8s_version` is the kubelet's own string (it may carry a leading `v`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster.
- `node_pool_id` (String) UUID of the node pool.

### Read-Only

- `machines` (Attributes List) The pool's machines, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))

<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `age_seconds` (Number) Age at the time of the read; changes on every read.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339); the zero time when unknown.
- `internal_ip` (String) First internal IP address; `""` until known.
- `k8s_version` (String) The kubelet's reported version, verbatim (may carry a leading `v`); `""` until the node reports one.
- `name` (String) Machine name.
- `status` (String) `Ready`, `NotReady`, `Provisioning` or `Deleting`.
